Give current forecast amounts in whole US dollars. A point repeats its amount in both bounds. Use null amounts for a directional change or no guidance. Direction is null for numeric guidance. Ignore old ranges, revenue, expenses, financing proceeds, past spending and capital for one project. If an annual target is absent use null fiscal_year. Continuing to invest alone does not state a direction. Briefly name the evidence in rationale in at most eight words. Never guess missing inputs.
